notes: Every San Francisco property page in Corcoran Icon's property sitemap (sitemap-property-dpages--0.xml), fetched 2026-11-25: 1,100 pages, 649 with listing remarks. Interiors, interior designers, landscape designers, renovation plans not built, and the roll's year built restated are not facts here.
